name: eklase-playwright
description: Playwright automation script to scrape homework for the current day and remaining days of the week.

scripts.pages:prepare: mkdir -p _site && cp homework.html _site/index.html && cp homework.html _site/homework.html && cp homework.json _site/ && cp homework.md _site/ && (cp -r attachments _site/ 2>/dev/null || true)
